# statecraft — agent documentation index

Use these files to understand the codebase before making changes.

## Core docs (read first)

- AGENTS.md — setup, architecture, testing, style
- statecraft.go — public API and quick start
- model/builder.go — how to declare machines (flat, compound, parallel, OnDone)
- model/compile.go — compile-time validation rules
- runtime/service.go — event loop, SCXML macrostep, done events

## Examples

- examples/trafficlight/main.go — simple cyclic FSM
- examples/authflow/main.go — guards, After timers, Final state, Subscribe
- examples/doceditor/main.go — parallel regions, OnDone, Save/Restore

## Tests (behavioral reference)

- model/compile_test.go — validation errors
- runtime/service_test.go — runtime semantics (flat, hierarchical, parallel, done events, After, invoke)
- persist/persist_test.go — Save/Restore round-trips
- actor/actor_test.go — supervision strategies
- testkit/harness_test.go — synchronous test patterns (AssertIn, AssertLeaves, OnDone)
- viz/viz_test.go — diagram output

## Package map

- core/ — Event, StateID, Clock, errors
- model/ — Builder, Machine, compound/parallel states, guards, actions, invoke, OnDone
- runtime/ — Service, Scheduler, Snapshot, subscribers, Restore
- actor/ — System, Ref, supervision (NoRestart, RestartAlways, RestartN)
- persist/ — Checkpoint, Save, Restore
- viz/ — ToMermaid, ToGraphviz (compound/parallel cluster rendering)
- testkit/ — Harness for deterministic tests (hierarchical/parallel aware)
- bench/ — performance benchmarks

## External Devin docs

- Devin CLI index: https://cli.devin.ai/docs/llms.txt
- Devin platform index: https://docs.devin.ai/llms.txt
